name: Advanced Floating Sliding Panel (Lite)
author: CodeTides

sections.description:
Transform your WordPress site with Advanced Floating Sliding Panel, the ultimate plugin for creating eye-catching sliding panels with unlimited tabs, animations, and customization options. Whether you need a vertical sliding panel for announcements or a horizontal sliding panel for notifications, this plugin makes it easy to engage visitors and boost conversions.

Upgrade Links

  • Upgrade to Pro Version
  • View Pro Live Demo
  • Compare Free vs Pro

What You Can Create

Advanced Floating Sliding Panel is a WordPress plugin that offers a wide range of features with beautiful design and great functionality.

  • Vertical Sliding Panels: Perfect for sidebars, announcements, or notifications.
  • Horizontal Sliding Panels: Ideal for top/bottom bars, promotions, or alerts.
  • Unlimited Tabs: Add single or multiple tabs for forms, videos, or custom content.
  • Floating Panels: Create floating panels that slide in/out based on user interaction.

Key Features

  • Vertical Sliding Panels: Perfect for sidebars, announcements, or notifications.
  • Horizontal Sliding Panels: Ideal for top/bottom bars, promotions, or alerts.
  • Unlimited Tabs: Add single or multiple tabs for forms, videos, or custom content.
  • Floating Panels: Create floating panels that slide in/out based on user interaction.
  • Multiple Tab Support: Design unlimited tabs with a pre-built theme builder.
  • Unlimited Panels: Create as many sliding panels as you need – no limits!
  • Responsive Design: Works flawlessly on mobile, tablets, and desktops.
  • Customizable Animations: Choose from slide-in, fade, or bounce effects.
  • Floating Panel Option: Add floating panels that stay visible as users scroll.
  • Easy-to-Use Interface: No coding required – set up in minutes.

Why Choose Advanced Floating Sliding Panel?

  • Boost Engagement: Catch visitors’ attention with dynamic sliding panels.
  • Increase Conversions: Use panels for announcements, promotions, or lead generation.
  • Save Time: Replace multiple plugins with one powerful tool.

Perfect For

  • Bloggers: Showcase announcements or newsletter signups.
  • E-commerce Stores: Promote flash sales or discounts.
  • Marketers: Highlight lead magnets or webinar signups.
  • Agencies: Create branded campaigns for clients.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the advanced-floating-sliding-panel folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. The plugin menu will appear in the left sidebar.
  4. Add floating sliding panels to display on your website.
sections.faq:
Where can I buy the pro version? Does it include free support?

You can buy the pro version here. Yes, it includes free support for any issues or bugs.

Does it require shortcodes to display on the website?

No, this plugin does not use shortcodes to display content.
